svg.title: Подъём ног на римском стуле — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two phases of a straight-leg raise on the vertical Roman chair/captain's chair. Same tall stable freestanding vertical knee-raise station with one back pad behind torso and a horizontal forearm support pad at EACH side. The athlete's forearms support his body on both pads, hands hold the two short vertical handles, back remains against upright pad. Left phase both straight legs hang unsupported under torso with feet off floor. Right both straight legs lift together to a clearly horizontal position in front, near hip height, toes visible. Show the equipment from side three-quarter angle. No dip, no pull-up bar, no hyperextension bench. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
